param.label: Reference genome
param.help: Optional reference, only used as guidance during scaffolding.

param.help: Searched in forward and reverse-complement orientation. Default: the canonical vertebrate motif CCCTAA.

param.label: Maximum divergence between haplotypes
param.help: Should be increased for species with divergence significantly higher than human. Default: 0.05.

Disable resolution of large rDNA tangles connecting multiple chromosomes

param.label: HiFi reads files
param.help: PacBio HiFi, ONT duplex, or HERRO/hifiasm-corrected ONT simplex reads.

param.name: nano
param.label: Oxford Nanopore reads files
param.help: Ultra-long ONT reads. If not provided, verkko is run with --no-nano.

param.label: Hi-C forward reads
param.help: Must be in the same order as the reverse reads. Interleaved files are not supported.

param.label: Do not perform Canu correction on HiFi reads
Haploid genome
param.help: Better ONT alignment for haploid genomes.

param.label: Correct k-mer size
param.help: k-mer size used for finding overlaps. Default: 425.

param.label: Correct k-mer window
param.help: Window size for sketching reads when finding overlaps. Default: 19.

param.label: Correct k-mer coverage
param.help: Maximum count of a k-mer to use for finding overlaps. Default: 1000.

validator.message: Only letters, digits, '_' and '-' are allowed

param.label: Do not produce read alignments to the assembly (CRAM)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Verkko is a hybrid genome assembly pipeline developed for telomere-to-telomere assembly of accurate long reads (PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore Duplex, HERRO or hifiasm corrected Oxford Nanopore Simplex) and Oxford Nanopore ultra-long reads. Verkko is Finnish for net, mesh and graph.
Verkko uses Canu to correct remaining errors in the HiFi reads, builds a multiplex de Bruijn graph using MBG, aligns the Oxford Nanopore reads to the graph using GraphAligner, progressively resolves loops and tangles first with the HiFi reads then with the aligned Oxford Nanopore reads, and finally creates contig consensus sequences using Canu's consensus module.
**Phasing**
Only one phasing mode can be used at a time:
- *Haplotype-specific k-mers*: parental (trio), Hi-C or Strand-seq derived meryl databases of homopolymer-compressed k-mers, assigned with Rukki. - *Hi-C*: paired Hi-C reads, used by Verkko2 for phasing and scaffolding. Forward and reverse files must be supplied in the same order. - *Pore-C*: Pore-C reads, used like Hi-C for phasing and scaffolding.
For Hi-C and Pore-C an optional reference can guide scaffolding, and the telomere motif and expected haplotype divergence can be adjusted.
**Contaminant screening**
Typical human contaminants (rDNA, mitochondria, EBV) can be screened out, and any number of additional contaminants can be given as named FASTA files.
**Outputs**
- Assembly FASTA, final homopolymer-compressed graph (with and without sequence), layout and scaffold map - HiFi and ONT coverage per graph node - Corrected HiFi reads (unless correction is disabled) - Read alignments to the assembly as CRAM (unless disabled) - When phasing: haplotype 1, haplotype 2 and unassigned sequences; for Hi-C/Pore-C also the haplotype paths and node colors
